title: 4 trucking dates that sneak up right after *New Year's*

items.title: Driver medical cards
items.body: Each one has its own date. Nobody remembers whose is first.

items.title: Liability and cargo policies
items.body: Lots of them renew Jan 1. The notice went to last year's email.

items.title: IFTA license and decals
items.body: Usually renewed for the calendar year. December goes fast.

items.title: Next year's UCR registration
items.body: Easy to forget until a shipper or inspector asks for it.
